Abstract excerpt: We introduce Malaria-Instruct, a curated instruction-following dataset derived from the ChEMBL Legacy Malaria corpus for Malaria virtual screening, and conduct a systematic evaluation of five open-source LLMs; Gemma-2 2B/9B, TxGemma-2B/9B, and LlaSMol-Mistral-7B, on a rigorous out-of-distribution data split. Performance was benchmarked against classical ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost) and frontier proprietary models (Gemini 2.5, OpenAI o3) under few-shot conditions.
